## Change

Describe the concrete behavior and compatibility impact.

## Validation

List meaningful tests and the runtimes used. Include regression coverage for
security or protocol changes; update documentation and CHANGELOG.md.

- [ ] Contract snapshots and shared fixtures pass.
- [ ] Commits include a DCO `Signed-off-by` line (`git commit -s`).
- [ ] No live credentials, production tokens or private keys are included.
